thread:
Priya: After yesterday's latency blast I want a single-line action format we can enforce and a short IC rotation tweak so no followups fall through the cracks.
Sam: Yes. Too many followups become 'maybe later'. keep it one-liner per action.
Maya: Suggest we require 1) owner ack within 24h and 2) a verification artifact before closing.
Priya: Draft action format (OpsBot-parsable):
```
Action: short summary
Owner: Full Name
Priority: P0/P1/P2
Due: YYYY-MM-DD or ASAP
Verify: link or screenshot
Rollback: optional
Notes: one-line
```
Jordan: Add field "CustomerImpact: yes/no" so we can prioritize customer-facing fixes.
Sam: Also a tiny timeline template for postmortem:
- t0: symptom detected
- t+5m: mitigation applied
- t+30m: traffic normalized
- t+Xh: followup actions created
Keep it as bullets so people don't write essays.
Maya: For recurring incidents: if same top symptom appears twice in 45 days, tag as "recurring" and open a 3-day spike.
Priya: Rotation plan: 1-week IC rotation by default, but teams can opt into 2-week. Require a 20-minute overlap handoff doc with: top open actions, active customer impacts, open runs/tests, where logs/dashboards live.
Jordan: OpsBot will parse actions pasted in raw, create a ticket with label incident-2345678901, ping owner, and schedule reminders at 24h and 72h. It will also nudge owners for ack at 24h.
Sam: Ownership lifecycle: owner ack in 24h, weekly owner pulse until Closed, if no ack escalate to team's on-call then incident lead.
Maya: Closure checks: owner marks Closed + attach verification artifact. For process-only items require PR link + reviewer.
Priya: Communication cadence: 24h internal status in thread, 72h public summary in #incidents, and customer note if external.
Jordan: I'll wire the calendar and OpsBot hooks. Can someone pilot this on infra for 6 weeks?
Sam: I'll run the pilot and report weekly digest of open/stale actions.
Maya: I'll draft the small verification checklist and sample screenshots.
Priya: Great. I'll update the postmortem template and add the action table. Schedule 30m review Friday 11:00 to confirm owners and pilot start.
OpsBot: Reminder configured: will create JIRA tickets for parsed actions, label=incident-2345678901, DM owners on assignment, send ack reminder at 24h, status reminder at 72h.
Jordan: Thanks all, let's keep the template rigid and the followups light.
